paper.title_en: Universal Mass Equation for Equal-Quantum Excited-States Sets~III
paper.abstract_en: Using our simple logarithmic Universal Mass Equation, we considered heavy non-$q\bar{q}$ meson states. PDG2026 reported a series of mesons with quantum numbers not allowed for standard $q\bar{q}$ states. Using LQCD predictions, we evaluated a scalar $0^{++}$ and tensor $2^{++}$ glueball series for which predictions are available. This approach allows us to predict heavy states that require future experimental studies. Additionally, we consider the possible misidentification of some meson states.
